summary: GLIDER, a drone instrument firmware built on M-VAVE's FM1 Open: white keys latch scale tones on and off, and black keys glide them along the scale like a steel guitar. A quiet microsound drum track runs underneath. Beta, tested on one unit.
features: Latching keys, up to 16 tones sounding at once
Black keys glide a tone 1 to 4 scale steps
25 scales, chord scales, equal or just intonation; 22 presets
Tape echo, ladder filter, delay and shimmer reverb; MIDI clock
27 synthesised microsound drum slots, 16 steps, probability and ratchets
MIDI notes play the keyboard, channel 10 the drums

headings: glider – drone synth firmware for the m-vave fm-1
